name: Grade 10 Mathematics Term 2 Exam
subject: Mathematics
instructions: Answer ALL questions. Show all working.

items.question: The value of sin(45 degrees) is?
The inverse of the matrix [[1,2],[3,4]] has determinant?
The equation of a circle with centre (0,0) and radius 5 is?

sections.heading: Section B: Written Questions (76 marks)
items: 1. Find the determinant of the matrix [[3, 4], [1, 2]]. (3 marks)
3. Given sin A = 0.6, find the value of cos A. (3 marks)
4. Find the length of the arc of a circle of radius 7 cm subtending an angle of 60 degrees at the centre. (4 marks)
6. A sum of money doubles in 5 years at simple interest. Find the rate. (4 marks)
